description: Measurement, no model involved. On the charter's schedule and after every released change a script measures the model the Steward lives in: every lane's status, kind, schedule and recent fires, errors, contract misses, stranded tokens, tokens per place, cost per lane. It writes the health summary, one row per lane, the model map and the budget, and starts an iteration when nothing is waiting for the person.

places.p-steward-health: Health per observation (the model summarised, with the trend)
places.p-steward-digest: The daily digest: the newest health condensed once a day, kept 30 days
places.p-steward-lane-report: The lane report: the newest lane measurement as a markdown table a person reads, kept 10
places.p-steward-lanes: One row per lane per observation
places.p-steward-map: The model map: nets, places, lanes and their kinds, measured
places.p-steward-budget: The daily budget: spent, remaining, exhausted
places.p-steward-candidates: Crystallisation and tuning candidates, measured per observation

transitions.label: Observe: lanes, places, errors, cost, map
transitions.description: steward-observe measures through master and the runtime's MCP (net_stats, list_transitions, scheduler_status, usage_report, net_overview) and writes health, lanes, map and budget; it starts an iteration when no prompt, spec or run is waiting.

transitions.label: Digest the newest health (daily)
transitions.description: Every morning at 06:00 Europe/Berlin it reads the newest health token without consuming it and writes one compact digest token, so the person reads a day at a glance instead of every observation. Nothing else moves: the observe lanes and their places are untouched.

template.text: Daily digest of ${health.data.at}: ${health.data.summary}; cost 24h ${health.data.costUsd24h} USD; executor ${health.data.executor}

transitions.label: Render the newest lane measurement as a table
transitions.description: steward-lane-report reads the rows of the newest p-steward-lanes observation and writes one lane-report token holding a markdown table, so the person reads the lanes instead of querying them. It measures nothing itself and touches no other place.

transitions.label: Report the lanes (daily)
transitions.description: Every morning at 06:10 Europe/Berlin, ten minutes after the digest, it reads the newest health token without consuming it and files one request for the lane report. The health read is the lane's preset and its guard: with no observation yet, nothing fires and no empty report is written.
